bottleneck.description: Largest domestic Chinese industrial-robot brand (~10% China share) plus vertically integrated servo/controller stack.

dependency.key_customers: Chinese photovoltaic, lithium battery, 3C electronics, welding integrators
dependency.key_suppliers: Internally integrated servo/controller; reducer imports (Nabtesco, Harmonic) historically

editorial.notes: Estun ranks #1 among Chinese robot brands at ~10.5% domestic share, but the China industrial-robot market is competitive (Inovance, Siasun, Efort) and global incumbents (Fanuc, Yaskawa, ABB, KUKA) still hold roughly 45% of Chinese share. Estun's customers can substitute robots within months. Vertical-integration is a margin advantage, not a bottleneck.
